Speaking as someone who likes these movies, the twist at the end is batshit even for this franchise. Did I see a different version of this movie to everyone else? Definitely the worse entry in the franchise, despite still being okay. 

The twist is the same as the first movie’s one except executed a lot worse. There are 3 more extra characters than there needs to be. Somehow there are more tricks shown but less magic in this movie. No big performance at the end from the Horsemen (they are on stage but they don’t say shit except goodnight). 

OG cast chemistry still rocks, but they were given a clunky script. The movie struggled to manage that many characters and makes a mess of it at the end, setting up for a fourth movie where we will still be trying to figure out the mystery of The Eye. Lots of references you won’t understand or enjoy unless you watched the first two movies. 

Lizzy Caplan is actually starring in this movie more than Morgan Freeman (not just a cameo) and is left out
